notes:
### Small machines, a truthful assistant, and the Catalog

- **Memory mode (low / balanced / max).** Models now unload 30 seconds after
  the whole pipeline goes quiet instead of five minutes after one queue
  empties. Low mode runs one lane at a time, drops models the moment a job
  ends, and picks the smallest model of every family without touching your
  saved choices. Setup seeds the mode from your hardware, and the Brain step
  tells a machine under 16 GB to pick a cloud brain.
- **Every AI stage without its own pick thinks with the chat brain.** Day
  summaries no longer alternate between two 27B models, swapping them in and
  out on every call.
- **The assistant builds a whole timeline as a document, never call by
  call.** Raw Resolve calls that build or fill a timeline are refused and
  point at the document tools; append_to_timeline places at most ten items.
  With Resolve connected the assistant's footage pool never knows less than
  it does with Resolve closed, so a project with no shoot-day timeline no
  longer reads as "no source clips".
- **Codex setup for MCP.** Settings and the wizard offer a tested "Copy setup
  for Codex" beside the Claude Code command; the connection card says which
  client each one is for.
- **The Archive page is called Catalog.** Nothing stored moves. The
  backup-coverage bar under the results is parked.
- **Setup runs once more for installs set up before 1.3.5**, opens on step
  one, and earns its ticks as you go instead of showing everything already
  done.
- **Resync applies the day document** for clips still unplaced, and one
  overlapping slow-motion clip no longer refuses a whole day: it goes on an
  overflow lane for that camera.
- **Quitting during "Reading metadata" no longer segfaults**, no model
  download starts during quit, and no stats worker spawns while the window
  is closing.
- **Marketplace switches tell the truth on every surface**, tools on the
  Deliver page have a working off switch, and the garage no longer caps at
  eight pins.
- **Licence key: a whole key pasted into any box fills all of them.**
- **Brain pill turns amber with "not installed"** when the chosen local
  model's files are not on disk, and chat says the same instead of failing.
- **New Project shows whether Resolve is open** under its Resolve switch.
  The Compute pill now reads Usage.
- **OpenAI models refreshed** (Astra, Sol, Terra, Luna tiers); assistant
  calls on OpenAI can be stopped mid-stream and are billed per call. Saved
  models survive the migration.
- **Diagnostics**: a failed upload names the likely cause and says the
  report is on your Desktop. The assistant's direct Resolve calls are
  recorded again; "Scan this machine" works on the second click; the Ollama
  shape warning no longer repeats per call.
- **A plan picked on small hardware no longer reads as "custom"**, and the
  unused auto-open-Resolve switch is gone.
